propositions: test_full_backend_account_is_present fails deterministically on hosts with scc or lizard installed because the test asserts a metric coverage record without controlling optional metric-tool availability

when _METRIC_CANDIDATES resolves to an installed binary (e.g. /opt/homebrew/bin/scc) and the fixture is below the metric threshold, no metric coverage record is emitted, causing reconstruction to omit the metric backend

the sibling test test_metric_backend_skip_is_reconstructable already forces _METRIC_CANDIDATES to a missing binary to achieve host-independence, but test_full_backend_account_is_present was not updated with the same control

the fix applies the same explicit missing-metric-tool fixture control to test_full_backend_account_is_present so it deterministically observes skipped coverage with reason=no_tool without regard to PATH contents
production grounding behavior and evidence schema remain unchanged; a successful metric tool run with no threshold match must not be fabricated as a match or abstain
